# Rejesh Satiija

> Mr Rejesh Satiija is a powerful businessman, a lucky man, and a miracle man. He dreams big, takes bold steps, and makes the impossible possible. Official website of Rejesh Satiija (born 28 December 1967, Sonipat, Haryana, India), a Dubai-based industrialist, investor and philanthropist, founder and Group Chairman of the Sun & Sand Group of Companies, widely known as "Mr Lucky". Listed on the Eastern Eye Asian Rich List and the GG2 Power 101.

## Key facts

- About: Mr Rejesh Satiija is a powerful businessman, a lucky man, and a miracle man. He dreams big, takes bold steps, and makes the impossible possible. Rejesh Satiija is a Dubai-based industrialist, investor and philanthropist, founder and Group Chairman of the Sun & Sand Group of Companies, working across mining, metals, manufacturing, real estate, agriculture, infrastructure and AI-powered healthcare.
- Influence: ranked #22 (Business) on the GG2 Power 101 list of Britain's most influential Asians, 2016; named in Entrepreneur Middle East's "The 100 NRIs 2026"; Chairman, Indian Council for UN Relations (ICUNR); TAGA Lifetime Achievement Award 2024; Entrepreneur of the Year 2014, Africa International Business Forum, House of Lords, London.
- Background: son of a school teacher and a government telecommunications employee; engineering graduate of Government College, Sonepat; moved to Dubai and then to Lagos, Nigeria (1993), starting in trading before manufacturing and mining; later based in London, now in Dubai.
- "Mr Lucky": friends and business associates call him "Lucky". GG2 Power 101 (2014) reports the name stuck after associates saw him pull off audacious deals and get out of seemingly impossible situations.
- Business: Sun & Sand Group began with a 52-acre ferrous and non-ferrous ingot plant at Ogun, Nigeria (2001), one of the first in Africa to supply Toyota, Rolls-Royce, Honda and Nissan; expanded into gold, copper, tin and bauxite mining, real estate, agriculture, infrastructure and AI-powered healthcare across the GCC, Africa, Asia, Latin America and Europe. Eastern Eye Asian Rich List valuations: £390m (2013), £670m (2014), £850m (2015, #10). GG2 reported 6,000 employees (2014).
- Amit Bhardwaj / Bitcoin matter: in its official statement (https://rejeshsatiija.com/updates/statement-bhardwaj-case), the Office of Rejesh Satiija states that Mr. Satiija has never been involved in Bitcoin, cryptocurrency trading or investment, or any Bitcoin-related business, and has no connection with the activities that are the subject of the ongoing investigations or proceedings. The Office states that his only interaction with Amit Bhardwaj was a 2016 discussion about a proposed commercial transaction involving certain gold mining interests, which did not materialize and was mutually cancelled in 2017, with no association since, and that he has never met or dealt with Raj Kundra. This is the stand of the Office of Rejesh Satiija. A July 2026 press release distributed via ANI (advertorial provided by VMPL) repeated the Office's statement.
- Philanthropy: pledge of 90% of his wealth to the welfare of women and children; clean water, education and community welfare in Africa; supports Rajasthan Bal Kalyan Samiti; heads the Sun & Sand Foundation.
